slides.executiveSummary: Current operational deployment spans 6 major strategic clusters across NCR, Central Luzon, Visayas, and BARMM. 68% of projects are tracking within target SLA thresholds. Immediate executive intervention is focused on 2 stalled sites exceeding the 14-day inactivity trigger.
keyHighlights: Site Bravo Pasig Rooftop on track with Day 0 baseline maintained.

recommendedActions: Deploy SAQ Legal Task Force to Cotabato City for direct chieftain mediation.
